verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a public API at api.incident.io with API-key auth. Its API reference covers endpoints, examples, authentication, rate limits and error handling, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec; separate Status Page and Widget APIs plus webhooks extend programmatic control. The probe's 404s only show the spec isn't at guessed well-known paths, which doesn't contradict the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and an OpenAPI spec at a standard discoverable path.
